newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC to form alliance with LTCB.
newsitem.headline: SBC to form alliance with LTCB.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp said it had signed a letter of intent to form a strategic alliance with Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd.

"The core of the alliance will be three Japan-based joint ventures to meet the needs of LTCB's and SBC's clients in investment banking, asset management and private banking in Japan and around the world," it said in a statement.
Each bank will take a three percent equity stake in the other to underscore the alliance, it said.
"The partners aim to create a leading Japan-based financial services provider," the statement said, adding more details would be released at a Tokyo news conference at 0800 GMT.

"The importance of the alliance is demonstrated by LTCB's commitment to purchase a three percent stake in the share capital of SBC, and SBC's commitment to purchase a three percent stake in the share capital of LTCB. LTCB and SBC will rank among each other's top five shareholders," it said.
